title: [SOLVED] Unable to resume after sleep/suspend on Kenel 7.1.x
body: I tested the kernels linux-7.1.2.arch2-1-x86_64, linux-7.1.2.arch3-1-x86_64 and linux-7.1.3.arch1-1-x86_64. In all of them after putting the laptop to sleep/suspend, it won't resume. Reverting back to an older kernel solves the issue. $ sudo journalctl -b -1 Jul 07 20:46:11 archlinux kernel: Linux version 7.1.3-arch1-1 (linux@archlinux) (gcc (GCC) 16.1.1 20260625, GNU ld (GNU
